## About
Mission Smog Test Only is a smog check shop at 27159 Mission Blvd in Hayward. We keep things simple: you pull in, we get your car tested, and you get back to your day.
Neighbors keep coming back. Some have been bringing their vehicles here for years and have sent their friends too. We're grateful for a 5 star rating from 522 Google reviews.
